sentences.text: Le matin, Léa donne du lait au chat.
sentences.translation: In the morning, Léa gives the cat some milk.

sentences.text: Minou aime dormir sur le lit.
sentences.translation: Minou likes to sleep on the bed.

sentences.text: Le soir, Léa joue avec son chat.
sentences.translation: In the evening, Léa plays with her cat.

sentences.text: Paul va au marché avec sa mère.
sentences.translation: Paul goes to the market with his mother.

sentences.text: Il achète des pommes et du pain.
sentences.translation: He buys some apples and some bread.

sentences.text: Les pommes sont rouges et belles.
sentences.translation: The apples are red and beautiful.

sentences.text: « Bonjour, je voudrais six pommes », dit Paul.
sentences.translation: "Hello, I would like six apples," says Paul.

sentences.text: Le marchand donne les pommes à Paul.
sentences.translation: The vendor gives the apples to Paul.
Paul pays and says thank you.

sentences.text: À midi, la famille mange une bonne tarte aux pommes.
sentences.translation: At noon, the family eats a nice apple tart.
